INDEPENDENT REVIEW — BLOCK 1535b50 on one narrow public-API defect; scientific behavior otherwise accepted.

CLEAN EVIDENCE: exact SHA 1535b50 is one five-path commit on landed base 0ce0bc7; current non-Mote advances are only AGENTS.md and align SignatureSuite, both disjoint. My isolated normal clone with grakern 0329c43 passed embedBench 47/47. I independently applied the complete survivor-renormalization mutant: ignoring missing both per case and at the final aggregate changed [Observed(1), Missing] into a published Observed(1.0), and MetricsSuite failed exactly the intended test; restoring byte-identically returned 12/12 green. The production WOG test reaches GraphHsmm through genuinely abstaining candidates, and the leakage consumer now propagates missing rather than dropping it. ADR 0003 codec/wire and sibling-seam checks are inapplicable here as stated.

REQUIRED AMENDMENT: the chief ratified public MetricObservation = Ineligible | Observed(Double) | Missing(reason), but the candidate declares `private[bench] case Observed(value: Double)` and exposes no public total eliminator. A consumer can construct a finite observation through MetricObservation.observed, but cannot read the value from public UnitObservation.observation outside package storymodel4s.bench. I proved this with an external-package compile probe: matching `case MetricObservation.Observed(value)` fails E173, object Observed cannot be accessed. The previous UnitObservation.value was publicly readable, so this is a real public usability regression, not style.

Minimal safe repair: keep the Observed constructor private so NaN/Infinity remain unrepresentable, but add a public total fold/visit method that forces callers to handle Ineligible, Observed(value), and Missing(reason), plus an external-package compile/runtime test. Do not add a bare Option accessor that recreates the conflation. No other required finding. I will review only the amendment delta and focused evidence; chief remains the sole merger/closer.
